description: This Dart source file defines a FileService class for managing file import, storage, and deletion within a Flutter application. It provides functionalities to pick files from the device, save them with unique filenames in the app's documents directory, generate metadata, and delete or verify managed files. The file also includes a metadata model for saved files.

classes.name: SavedFileMetadata
classes.description: A data model representing metadata for a file saved locally by the app, including name, MIME type, size, and local path.

classes.name: FileService
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to pick, save, delete, and verify files within the app's documents directory, abstracting file management operations.

methods.name: pickAndSaveFiles
methods.description: Prompts the user to select one or multiple files using a file picker, saves each file into the app's documents directory, and returns their metadata.

methods.name: _savePickedPlatformFile
methods.description: Saves a single PlatformFile into the app's documents directory with a unique filename, copying from path if available or reading bytes/stream otherwise, and returns its metadata.

methods.name: _resolveUniqueTargetFile
methods.description: Generates a unique file name within the app's documents directory by appending counters if necessary.

methods.name: _deriveFileName
methods.description: Generates a safe filename from a PlatformFile's name or path.

methods.name: _detectMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file based on provided metadata and file path.

methods.name: deleteStoredFile
methods.description: Deletes a managed file given its absolute path, only if it resides within the app's documents directory.

methods.name: isManagedFile
methods.description: Checks if a file at the given path exists and is within the app's documents directory.
